Last completed migration number written by setCompleted and read by upgrade.
Current network price adjusted by adjustPrice using load and capacity.
Timestamp of last price update, compared against block timestamp cooldown.
Role membership store backing hasRole and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE checks.
Per-wallet approved token amount retrievable after token launch completion.
Running total of approved amounts reconciled against seller balance.
Guard status variable enforced by the nonReentrant modifier.
Storage array of delegation records identified by delegation id.
Library function sending ETH with call{value:} forwarding all gas.
Code-size check implemented with extcodehash inline assembly.
Initializer granting DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to the caller and setting contract manager.
Internal ownership check against DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE for msg.sender.
Recalculates price from total load and capacity using timestamp cooldown.
Owner-restricted setter for last_completed_migration.
Owner-restricted function that calls setCompleted on an arbitrary address.
External entry point verifying node ownership and paying a computed bounty.
Internal payout that mints SKL to the Distributor via the token.
Restricted mint function that increases supply and triggers ERC777 recipient hooks.
Transfers approved tokens to caller then locks them in TokenLaunchLocker.
Internal approval accounting updating approved amounts and total approved.
Creates a delegation proposal, processes slashing signals and locks tokens.
Requests undelegation, updating delegated amounts and lockers.
Slashes a validator stake by reducing delegated values and logging the event.
Transfers accumulated bounty to a destination after lockup elapsed.
Registers a node for the calling node operator through SkaleManager.

Computes the current month index from the block timestamp.
Signature recovery using ecrecover with malleability checks.
Finalizes DKG failure by rotating nodes and slashing the bad node.
Broadcasts DKG verification vectors and key shares from a group node.

Computes locked amount considering delegated and pending delegation values.
Computes and reduces bounty from the stage pool using time-based metrics.
ERC777 recipient callback that forwards userData to Schains.addSchain.

Caller controlled address used for access control and ownership decisions.

Subtraction accounting on _totalApproved when approvals decrease.

edges.reason: sendValue forwards all available gas with call{value:} allowing the recipient to reenter.
isContract derives the result from extcodehash inline assembly.
initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to the caller address msg.sender.
_setupRole writes admin role membership into the _roles mapping.
_isOwner resolves ownership by checking the role of msg.sender.
_isOwner queries role membership stored in _roles.
restricted modifier requires msg.sender to equal the stored owner.
setCompleted writes the last_completed_migration state variable.
upgrade reads last_completed_migration and forwards it to the new contract.
upgrade performs an external call to setCompleted on an attacker supplied address.
adjustPrice requires now to exceed lastUpdated plus the cooldown period, a timestamp dependency.
adjustPrice reads and later overwrites the lastUpdated timestamp.
adjustPrice updates the stored price based on load and capacity.
adjustPrice computes the price change with chained multiplications and divisions.
adjustPrice resolves ConstantsHolder, Nodes and SchainsInternal through dynamic lookups.
getBounty requires nodes.isNodeExist(msg.sender, nodeIndex) before paying out.
getBounty delegates the calculation to the Bounty contract.
getBounty calls _payBounty when the computed bounty is positive.
_payBounty mints SKL to the Distributor which triggers ERC777 recipient hooks.
SkaleToken.mint invokes the recipient tokensReceived hook back into SkaleManager.
tokensReceived resolves Schains through contractManager.getContract and creates a schain.
retrieve reads the approved amount of the caller from the approved mapping.
retrieve performs an external ERC20 transfer before the token lock is recorded.
retrieve calls TokenLaunchLocker.lock which interacts with the locker contract.
_approveTransfer updates the _totalApproved accounting variable.
_setApprovedAmount subtracts the delta from _totalApproved when approvals decrease.
delegate uses msg.sender as the delegation holder and eligibility subject.
delegate resolves the current month via TimeHelpers before recording statistics.
getCurrentMonth derives the month index from the block timestamp.
confiscate reduces delegation values and appends a slashing event.
confiscate determines the current month before applying the slashing coefficient.
requestUndelegation mutates delegation records and their finish month.
requestUndelegation requires msg.sender to be the holder or the validator.
withdrawBounty performs an external ERC20 transfer to a caller supplied destination.
withdrawBounty credits and pays the caller msg.sender.
withdrawBounty requires now to be past launchTimestamp plus the lockup months.
finalizeSlashing triggers Punisher.slash which confiscates delegation stake.
finalizeSlashing resolves NodeRotation, SchainsInternal and SlashingTable dynamically.
broadcast resolves KeyStorage through the contract manager to store key material.
broadcast requires _isNodeByMessageSender(nodeIndex, msg.sender) to pass.
createNode associates the created node with the caller msg.sender via SkaleManager.
createNode stores the block timestamp as the node last reward date.
setContractsAddress updates the dynamic contract registry used by all lookups.
setContractsAddress is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier using msg.sender.
setContractsAddress validates the new address with the isContract helper.
removeSpaceFromNode is limited by allowTwo checks against msg.sender.
Locker query paths are exercised inside nonReentrant guarded token hook execution.
recover derives the signer using the ecrecover opcode with checks on s and v.
SkaleToken.mint triggers _callTokensReceived which is protected by the nonReentrant guard.
Bounty.getBounty compares the current timestamp against reward periods and launch time.
nodeExit validates the caller against node ownership or validator identity.
upgrade is restricted by the restricted modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
The nodeIndex parameter flows into the space removal logic.
The amount parameter flows into approval transfer accounting.
The delegationId parameter selects the delegation being undelegated.
The validatorId parameter selects the stake targeted by slashing.
The contract manager address parameter is stored during initialization.
The new_address parameter is instantiated as the upgrade target contract.
The local approved value is the amount sent by the external transfer.
The local load difference feeds the price change computation.
The local price change is added to or subtracted from the stored price.
The local bounty value is produced by the Bounty calculation helpers.
The local current month indexes delegation statistics updates.
The local locked amount aggregates locker results before comparison.

normalization_plan.reason: nodeIndex is only meaningful as the node identifier argument of the space management function.
amount is the value argument consumed by the approval accounting helper.
delegationId is the lookup key selecting the delegation being undelegated.
validatorId selects the validator stake that is slashed by confiscate.
the contract manager address argument is stored by the initializer.
new_address is the target contract instantiated by the upgrade function.
the local value is the amount passed to the external token transfer.
loadDiff exists only inside the price adjustment computation.
priceChange is the intermediate delta applied to the stored price.
bounty is the computed payout value produced by the bounty calculation.
currentMonth is derived and used only for delegation statistics updates.
locked aggregates locker totals solely for the locked amount computation.
